en.headline: OASES to announce next batch of 10 to 20 strategic enterprises on Thursday
en.dek: Director-general Peter Yan said the intake would be split evenly between mainland and overseas firms, including top pharmaceutical companies, with many valued above HK$100 billion.
body: The Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises will publish the names of its next batch of strategic enterprises and hold a signing ceremony on Thursday, director-general Peter Yan said on Sunday.

Yan said the batch would comprise around 10 to 20 firms, roughly half from the mainland and half from overseas. Many are leading companies with market capitalisations above HK$100 billion, including top pharmaceutical firms that will conduct clinical trials and research and development in Hong Kong.

Since its establishment nearly four years ago, OASES has attracted 124 strategic enterprises expected to bring about HK$73 billion in investment and create 25,000 jobs. Yan said the office is currently in talks with more than 100 companies and that firms must submit five-year plans covering investment, job creation and a flagship project.
He stressed that selection is based on alignment with Hong Kong’s industrial policy and contribution to the ecosystem, rather than size, listing status or investment volume alone.

zh.headline: 引進辦周四公布新一批十多至二十間重點企業
zh.dek: 主任任景信指新一批內地與海外企業各佔約一半，包括頂尖藥廠，不少市值逾千億元。
body: 引進重點企業辦公室主任任景信周日表示，辦公室將於周四公布新一批重點企業名單並舉行簽署儀式。
任景信指，預計有十多至二十間企業落戶，內地與海外各佔約一半，當中不少是市值逾千億元的龍頭企業，包括將在港進行臨床測試及新藥研發的頂尖藥廠。
引進辦成立近四年以來，累計已成功引進124間重點企業，預計帶來約730億元投資及2.5萬個就業職位。他表示目前正接洽超過100間企業，並要求落戶企業提交五年計劃，列明投資、職位及首個標竿項目。
任景信強調，挑選企業最重要是能否對接本港產業政策及有助生態發展，而非單看規模、上市或投資額。
